text_block_list.text:
Just before the Arima Kinen—
With tensions running high, Christmas arrived—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, were you surprised?
I prepared it while you were away, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's not just room decorations!
We've also prepared carrot cake, you know!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"A token of appreciation for always taking care of me♪
Once again, Trainer, Merry Christmas!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad.
You smiled, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, it seemed like you've been
on high alert this whole time lately..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "—The other day, you helped me out so much, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So this time, I was thinking
maybe there's something I could do for you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Thank you, for doing this for me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No thanks needed!
After all—this is for my sake too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Right before the big race,
there might not be time to let our guard down, but――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to cherish it.
This time spent with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I have a battle I cannot lose,
I want to carry it all, face the race, and win!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why today, Trainer and I—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaah!?
T-Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's carry “this moment” into the race too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's eat the cake right away!
I'll cut the slices!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that looks wickedly delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh—O-Of course I know that!
It's right before an important race, after all!"

That night turned into a memorable Christmas,
offering a nice breather right before the decisive battle.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...It's kind of mysterious.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I...
I've never had a Christmas like this before.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's right before the Arima Kinen...
I'm so nervous and my heart is pounding, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it's so much fun.
It's truly, tru~ly, so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I want to become the Umamusume who enjoyed Christmas the most in all of Japan today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So――Trainer,
let's do lots of Christmas-y things together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "First the cake, and after that... Oh, there are Santa hats here, let's put them on!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We can eat chicken, and then, and then—
Uuu~! There's so much I want to do, I can't decide what to start with!
choice_data_list: We'll do everything we can think of!
Let's do everything we can think of!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes!

That night turned into a memorable Christmas,
offering a nice breather right before the decisive battle.
